content: उपद्रवः .²1 An unhappy accident, misfortune, calamity. .²2 Injury, trouble, harm; पुंसामसमर्थानामुपद्रवायात्मनो भवेत्कोपः <ls>Pt. 1. 324</ls>; निरुपद्रवं स्थानम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²3 Outrage, violence. .²4 A national distress (whether caused by the king or famine, seasons <ab>&c.</ab>). .²5 A national disturbance, rebellion. .²6 A symptom, a supervenient disease (one brought on whilst a person is suffering from another). .²7 The sixth part of a Vedic sāman consisting of seven limbs. अथ सप्तविधस्य वाचि सप्तविधं सामोपासीत … यदुपेति स उपद्रवः <ls>Ch. Up. 2. 8. 2</ls>. .²8 A servant; अनृग्यजुरसामा च प्राजापत्य उपद्रवः <ls>Mb. 12. 60. 44</ls>. .²9 Loss, waste; अष्टकापितृदेवत्यमित्ययं प्रसृतो जनः . अन्नस्योपद्रवं पश्य मृतो हि किमशिष्यति .. <ls>Rām. 2. 108. 14</ls>.
